messages:
oliver (pm): Quick sync: want to standardize a 'pin-exempt' policy for catalog migrations. Problem: customers expect explicit control but we also want low-friction rollouts. Draft proposal below.
jin (eng): +1. Need clear automation for exempted pins so we don't accidentally migrate them.
tara (sre): Ops constraints: exempt pins must bypass auto-ramp and never be in canary cohorts. Also create alert if pinned-exempt traffic > X% to avoid stealth load.
mike (customer-eng): Customers care about two things: 1) No silent changes; 2) an easy opt-out flow. Suggest a console toggle and an API flag.
zoe (prod-ops): Comms: show "Pinned (exempt)" badge in console and include a link to request temporary opt-in for testing. Also we should allow time-limited exemptions (TTL).
jin (eng): Suggested policy fields (yaml):
```yaml
pin_exempt_policy:
  exempt_by_default: false
  ttl_days_default: 90
  auto_exempt_if_enterprise: true
  opt_in_flow:
    console: true
    api: true
  bypass_canary: true
  notify_on_change: [email, console]
```
tara (sre): Operational rules: 1) pinned-exempt models skip all automated canaries; 2) if a pinned-exempt model receives >5% of cluster GPU resources for >10m, page infra; 3) record audit entry for any manual migration.
mike (customer-eng): For enterprise customers, propose auto_exempt_if_enterprise=true but require legal-approved SLA change. Need Sales signoff.
zoe (prod-ops): For TTLs — allow admins to set a custom TTL per pin (up to 365 days). After TTL expiry, pin reverts to normal and is eligible for migration. Show calendar in console.
jin (eng): CLI examples: `rcli pins list --filter exempt=true` and `rcli pin set --tenant <t> --model <m> --exempt --ttl 180d`. We'll gate the `exempt` flag behind a permission.
oliver (pm): Decision points: - default exempt policy (false vs true for enterprise) - TTL defaults (90 vs 180) - notification channels (email+console vs email+console+webhook)
mike (customer-eng): Customer ask: default false but enterprise opt-in w/ sales friction is fine. TTL 180 preferred by customers who have long release cycles.
tara (sre): I vote 90 to keep ops manageable. We can increase per request.
zoe (prod-ops): Recommend default 90, allow admin override to 365. Notifications: email+console + webhook for SSO-integrated customers.
jin (eng): I'll implement the backend flags and the CLI permission checks. ETA: 2 sprints for API+CLI+console UI.
oliver (pm): I'll draft the comms and a short FAQ. Also add audit log requirement: every exempt action writes to audit with actor and reason.
ops-bot: scheduled job created: `pin-policy-apply 1777777000 --policy pin_exempt_policy_v1` :gear:
jin (eng): One more: edge case — when a pinned-exempt model has a security patch needing immediate rollout. Propose emergency migration flow: product + security signoff triggers a temporary override with immediate notify and 7-day grace for customer rollback.
mike (customer-eng): Must notify customers 24h before emergency override when possible. If CVE critical, override immediately but include phone escalation.
oliver (pm): OK consensus: default_exempt=false, default_ttl=90, enterprise_allow=true (requires sales/legal signoff), notifications email+console+optional webhook, emergency override process documented. I'll post final policy doc and request signoffs.
jin (eng): No objections.
tara (sre): I'll add alerting rules and the emergency playbook to runbook.
zoe (prod-ops): I'll prepare console badges and TTL UI mocks.
mike (customer-eng): I'll prepare customer-facing language and the support script.
oliver (pm): Thanks everyone — closing. Will follow up with PR to the policy repo and a quick demo next week.
